content_json.title: Use a seven-day launch countdown
content_json.what_it_means: People remember a launch better when they see it many times in different ways.
what_to_do: Post one simple launch update every day for seven days.
Show samples, price range, order steps, delivery area, and launch offer.
Repeat the same update on WhatsApp status.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can run a seven-day countdown for {{audience}} in {{location}} with one product video each day.
content_json.why_this_helps: A countdown gives people time to notice, ask questions, and share it with friends.
content_json.how_to_check: Check story views, replies, saves, and WhatsApp messages during the seven days.
